terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.s1Body: By accessing and using Pdfumi (https://pdfumi.com), you agree to these Terms. Pdfumi provides cloud software (Software as a Service - SaaS) and digital document processing utilities.

seo.title: Privacy Policy — Pdfumi
seo.description: Learn how Pdfumi protects your documents and data. Zero persistent file retention.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.s1Body: Your privacy is paramount. Uploaded and generated PDF files are processed in-memory or in isolated temporary directories. Files are purged automatically upon download or within 24 hours. We never read, inspect, or sell your documents.
privacy.s2Body: We collect only your email address when you register for an account or subscribe to a paid plan. We store usage counts to enforce fair quotas.
privacy.s3Body: Payment transactions are processed by certified payment provider Midtrans (QRIS, International Credit/Debit cards Visa/Mastercard/JCB, E-Wallets, and Virtual Accounts). We never store or handle your credit card numbers or PINs.
privacy.s4Body: We use browser local storage solely to keep your authentication session and API key on your device. We do not use third-party tracking cookies.
privacy.s5Body: For privacy requests or data deletion, contact privacy@pdfumi.com.

refund.title: Refund Policy
